newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Yields fall on Bulgaria 1-, 4-wk discount T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Yields fall on Bulgaria 1-, 4-wk discount T-bills.

text.p: Yields fell further at Friday's auctions of Bulgaria's Finance Ministry one-week and four-week discount T-bills, central bank figures showed.
The average yields to maturity of the two issues were 2.44 percent and 14.16 percent, respectively, down from 2.75 and 14.96 percent at Thursday's auctions.
Bids were received for a total of 116.872 billion levs of T-bills for today's auctions but the ministry approved bids for 61.887 billion levs worth of paper.
The issues were offered with no par value or minimum acceptable price set in advance by the ministry. Auction date and maturity date for each issue overlap.
The ministry has issued one-week and four-week discount T-bills daily since January 20 to regulate banks' liquidity.
Details of the issues follow. Prices in percent of par:
Bids received 57,570.9 million levs 59,301.4 million levs
Bids approved 13,585.9 million levs 48,301.4 million levs
Avg yield to maturity 2.44 pct 14.16 pct
